errors: The product formula for α'²β'² in (E) is not consistent with every version of the factors written on the page. With the first set (β'²/α'²=−β/α, α'²/γ'²=−(α−γ)/(β−γ), α'²γ'²=+(αγ−1)/(βγ−1)) the product is +(β/α)(α−γ)(αγ−1)/((β−γ)(βγ−1)), with a plus sign. With the third set the factor comes out as (β−γ)/(α−γ). The page holds several trial sign conventions, and the final line matches at most one of them.

Several trial three-term radical relations, e.g. √(xη)−√(yζ)+√((ξ+η+ζ)(x+y+z)) and √(xη)−√(ξy)+√((ξ+η+ζ)(x+y+z)), are incompatible with the characteristic table. Their pair sums differ, e.g. x+η=[110;110] but (x+y+z)+(ξ+η+ζ)=[101;101]. These are exploratory trials, some struck out, not errors in a final result.
The mod-2 column sum '... = 0' in the transcription, as read, does not sum to zero; its exact entries are unclear in the image.

results.what: Assignment of the 28 odd genus-3 theta characteristics to the bitangents of a quartic in the normal form √(xξ)+√(yη)+√(zζ)=0, with linear forms αx+βy+γz, ξ/α+η/β+ζ/γ, etc.
results.modern_name: Riemann's normal form of a plane quartic / Aronhold set and the correspondence between bitangents and odd theta characteristics
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (lectures c. 1861-62; 'Zur Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen für den Fall p=3', Werke 1876), Weber (1876), with Aronhold and Hesse for the bitangent combinatorics

results.what: Criterion that √(pP)±√(qQ)±√(rR)=0 represents the curve only when the three pairs have equal characteristic sum; finding the alternative forms with sums [110;110] and [101;101]
results.modern_name: Steiner complexes (6 pairs of bitangents per even characteristic, 63 complexes)
results.usually_credited_to: Steiner, Hesse (1855); Riemann/Weber in theta language

results.what: Transforming parameters (α,β,γ) to the parameters of a different Riemann normal form (α'²,β'²,γ'²)
results.modern_name: change of Aronhold set / action of Sp(6,F2) on normal forms

deep.surprise_reason: This is working material for Riemann's own genus-3 theory: the normal form √(xξ)+√(yη)+√(zζ)=0, odd characteristics on the 28 bitangents, and Steiner-complex pairings. That theory is published under his name (Werke) and was developed in Weber's 1876 monograph. The page shows computational detail, including the parameter transformation, but nothing beyond what is attributed to him.

checkable.asserts: all 18 characteristics in the table are odd
x+ξ = y+η = z+ζ = (0,1,1,0,1,1), i.e. [011;011]: the normal form's pairs lie in one Steiner complex
nonzero (equals 2x the product), showing the sign discrepancy in α'²β'² for the first set of factors
